hook: The Berry phase appears as the first correction in the minimal action of slowly driven oscillators.
summary: For a one-degree-of-freedom Hamiltonian system whose parameters change slowly around a loop, the paper shows the minimal action has an expansion in the slowness whose first coefficient is the classical Berry phase. The result is proved mathematically for exact convex functions, so no adiabatic approximation is used. The expansions are only asymptotic, not convergent, and the setting is limited to one degree of freedom.
title: Berry phase and Hannay angle as Taylor coefficients of the minimal action
